title: "Lecture 8 Team Projects"
subtitle: "Embedded Options and Option-Adjusted Measures"
---

## Project 1: Callable Bond Relative-Value Review

**Scenario.** Choose between a callable corporate bond and a comparable option-free alternative.

**Objectives.** Compare yield to worst, static spread, call schedule, and reinvestment risk; explain the embedded call; evaluate rate-volatility scenarios.

**Sources.** Bond trades from the [FINRA Trade Reporting and Compliance Engine (TRACE)](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income), terms from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/), and government curves from the [U.S. Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView), [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/115), or the [Bank of Canada](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/interest-rates/canadian-bonds/). If a matched pair is unavailable, use the documented [Lecture 8 fallback optionality snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-8-optionality.csv).

**Deliverables.** Term sheet, call timeline, spread comparison, three scenarios, recommendation, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Terms 20; spread analysis 25; optionality 30; recommendation 15; presentation and sourcing 10.

## Project 2: Backward Induction in an Interest-Rate Tree

**Scenario.** Explain audibly how callability or putability changes bond value.

**Objectives.** Price option-free and embedded-option bonds in a small tree; apply exercise rules; test volatility, exercise-price, and spread sensitivity.

**Sources.** A government curve from the [U.S. Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView) or [Bank of Canada](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/interest-rates/canadian-bonds/), plus an issuer exercise schedule from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/). If these cannot be aligned, use the documented tree, bond terms, and exercise schedule in the [Lecture 8 fallback optionality snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-8-optionality.csv).

**Deliverables.** Node spreadsheet, values, exercise map, three sensitivities, audit note, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Setup 20; induction 30; exercise logic 20; sensitivities 20; presentation 10.

## Project 3: Mortgage Extension Risk Case

**Scenario.** Advise whether an agency mortgage fund suits an investor worried about both falling and rising rates.

**Objectives.** Explain prepayment, contraction, extension, and negative convexity; compare the fund with a Treasury benchmark; analyze three rate-path scenarios.

**Sources.** Agency mortgage-backed security (MBS) exchange-traded fund (ETF) fact sheets, [Fannie Mae](https://capitalmarkets.fanniemae.com/mortgage-backed-securities) or [Freddie Mac](https://capitalmarkets.freddiemac.com/mbs/) disclosures, and mortgage and Treasury rates from [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/114). If analytics are unavailable, use the documented [Lecture 8 fallback optionality snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-8-optionality.csv).

**Deliverables.** Cash-flow explanation, benchmark comparison, three scenarios, suitability conclusion, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Security understanding 25; benchmark analysis 20; scenario reasoning 25; suitability judgment 20; presentation and citations 10.

## Project 4: OAS Assumption Audit

**Scenario.** Two vendors report different OAS values for the same callable bond; identify why and decide which is decision-useful.

**Objectives.** Compare curves, volatility, prepayment/exercise assumptions, and model structure; reconcile static spread and OAS; assess model risk.

**Sources.** An issuer prospectus from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/), [FINRA Fixed Income Data](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income), and public model-methodology notes. If two comparable vendor outputs are unavailable, use the two-model option-adjusted spread (OAS) results and assumptions in the documented [Lecture 8 fallback optionality snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-8-optionality.csv).

**Deliverables.** Assumption inventory, OAS reconciliation, sensitivity table, model-risk recommendation, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Assumption audit 25; reconciliation 25; sensitivities 20; model-risk judgment 20; presentation and attribution 10.
